## Appearance

Adam is a fine-looking, pure white rooster. He boasts a lovely, curved white tail, though it has been described as lacking in length.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048), [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P23](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0023)_

## Personality

Adam is an intelligent rooster. His keen awareness allows him to perceive a fatal threat in those who have a history of killing poultry.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL P11](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0011)_

## Traits

- intelligent  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL P11](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0011)</sub>

## History

Adam was a pet rooster who was originally given to [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) by Mrs. Johnson at [Juneford](../codex/places.md#juneford) and raised by [Grace](../character/grace.md) from a tiny yellow chick after his siblings were slain by a weasel. He was named after Mrs. Johnson's spouse.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII.
